name: pharmatrack-pro
description: Multi-tenant pharmacy management SaaS: batch-level inventory, FEFO billing, purchases, alerts and analytics on Supabase.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:db && npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
